proposed_facts.reason: Canonical local code confirms the zero comparison, descriptor argument, callback and three writes. Integer parts setters/getters and transfer into model idx independently establish numeric selection rather than pointer semantics.
The local guard and shield callee support descriptor/callback configuration conditional on remembered model selection 2 being zero. No visual-asset or collision-occupancy inference is required.
Neither the complete local initializer nor the shield callee modifies prev. Eligible repeated calls repeat setup; nonzero selection skips it.

Common dispatch includes Link and Young Link, and the selector explicitly branches between C-stick and left-stick input. Local callback installation and countdown initialization are restricted to AttackAirLw.

Canonical comparisons confirm positive-entry countdown subtraction, nonpositive-result and strict end-frame guards, and three indexed operations. Shared animation is unconditional and contains facing reversal and Fall entry. The proposal preserves overshoot and zero/negative-speed exceptions.

Local source and collision helpers establish the configured hit response and guarded capsule updates. The engine citation independently shows callback replacement and clearing. The proposal appropriately warns against assuming survival and defers complete restart-state lifetime rather than asserting an unconditional engine outcome.
